sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.0% (sc:70620@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Thank you for providing your data on delivery performance and volume forecasts. As to the delivery record and volume change data you cited, that does not change our position. While we have reviewed these points, our pricing structure must remain firm at this time.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. We can offer a slight adjustment to €4.95 per unit if you are able to accommodate 14-day payment terms, providing an alternative at a price of €4.95 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 12 months.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have carefully reviewed your latest proposal. However, we must maintain our previous offer of €5.02 per unit for the 90-day payment term. We are unable to accommodate further price reductions at this time.

To be completely clear, our offer stands at a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. Please keep in mind that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value our partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply and always aim to support your operations with our extensive inventory, top-tier bearing solutions, and dedicated service. We hope this proposal works well for your upcoming requirements.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always appreciate working with you and supporting your business with our extensive range and dedicated service.

Regarding our current negotiations, this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), valid for 7 days. Please decide on these terms. We are offering a price of €5.02 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months. 

Please consider this our final offer. However, we are unable to offer further concessions and must maintain our price at €5.02 for a 90-day payment term. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.

We look forward to hearing your decision soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
